text: Humongris can be found on the largest Gloaming Reef island off the coast of Val'sharah. He wields the mage Padawsen in his hand like a wand.
Huln's Rise is a small hill near the Sylvan Falls and Whitewater Wash in Highmountain.

Hrydshal is a vrykul city located in southern Stormheim. It serves as the traditional home for the Tideskorn clan, and specifically the Drekirjar, notorious for their taming of the local storm drakes. As the largest settlement in Stormheim, Hrydshal is a major feature in the region and contains one of the largest concentrations of vrykul on the Broken Isles.

__NOTOC__ Hudson Crawford is a human located in Bradensbrook in Val'sharah. He briefly worked with the Huntmaster of the Unseen Path and asked them to kill Risen Hounds and Captain Tevaris that threatened the village. He also defends the village during Legion Assaults.
Huge Highmountain Salmon Schools can be found in the waters of... in the Broken Isles.
Huge Runescale Koi Schools can be found in the river of Moonwhisper Gulch of Suramar.

The Human Forces were a group of humans from Kul Tiras and dwarves that set up a camp in newly established orcish homeland of Durotar led by Daelin Proudmoore. They also had ships and a lumber mill in Thunder Ridge that drove the thunder lizards mad. They destroyed Gar'thok's watch post and in turn their camp was then razed by Rexxar, Rokhan, Chen Stormstout, and Nazgrel. They later set up a meeting with Thrall in Razor Hill but the mok'nathal insisted to go in his stead. As the human emissary showed up, it was revealed to be a trap, and the emissary's escort attacked Rexxar, but were defeated. A group of the forces later appeared in Dustwallow Marsh in a small camp. There was Captain Thornb
Hrydshal Etching was never made available. Draining the magic from it would leave behind a version that could be vendored.

Hudson Archaeological is the archaeology trainer building of Boralus, a successor to Things of the Past. The building is located in the Tradewinds Market and is run by Jane Hudson. A pair of Junior Excavators can be found outside. The house has various items from the Zandalari trolls, Highmountain tauren, nightborne, and mogu displayed.
Humanizing Potion is provided for Corner Crossing and Tracking Tipoff in Redridge Mountains. It transforms the player into Sophia and Dark Ranger Lyana into Marion Sutton.
Hungering Stalkers are felstalkers located on the Broken Shore and Dalaran's Underbelly. They also appear in Azsuna, Highmountain, Stormheim, and Val'sharah during the Legion Assaults.
The Hungering Deepwater Treads drop from Twilight Lord Bathiel in the Moonshrine Sanctum in Blackfathom Deeps.
Humongous is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island.

Hozen Rummagers inhabited the site of the Wreck of the Sky Shark in the Jade Forest before the zeppelin crashed into the continent. Likely enraged by the sudden explosions and rapid influx of strange people, they have reacted violently against the Horde survivors. They can be found primarily within the hozen camps, and are the only ones of their kind in the area that are both armed and armored.
Hrolskald the Fetid is a vargul who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Hozen Flyers are winged hozen that attack the Brewfest Grounds in Dun Morogh and Durotar during Brewfest.
Hulking Azerite are Azerite elementals who can be encountered on Island Expeditions.
The Humming Black Dragonscale drops from Wrathion, the Black Emperor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

The Hungering Wastes is the northwestern portion of the Beastwarrens island in the Maw. The wastes are bordered clockwise to the northeast by the Soulstained Fields, the east by the Prodigum, and to the south by Marrow's Coppice.
Hungering Anima is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Huddled Carvings is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Hungerstone is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Hungering Runeblade was a level 60 Frost death knight ability. It was only present for a short time at the beginning of the alpha before it was replaced with Remorseless Winter.
Huezeki Windsong is a Highmountain tauren located in Zaralek Cavern.

A hunter trap is a trap that Survival hunters can set on the ground. A trap produces a damaging or slowing effect to enemies who come within its range. The ability to set traps is exclusive to hunters.
Huricanian is a rare mob air elemental found patrolling the mountain just southeast of the Crystal Vale in Silithus. Killing it grants 25 reputation with the Hydraxian Waterlords.
Huntsman Markhor is a forest troll stable master located in Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands. He hates arcane magic.

__NOTOC__ Huraan was a draenei quest giver located in the Southshore inn in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He appeared to be interested in a shipment of crystals that the Forsaken had stolen. After Southshore is destroyed, he is nowhere to be found.
Huntress of the Sun is a monument found amidst the Ruins of Silvermoon. It depicts a golden female elf firing her bow into the sky, standing atop a large medallion.
The Hungry Bog Lord is a fungal giant. It appears briefly as part of a scripted event sequence upon completion of Stealing Back the Mushrooms in Zangarmarsh.

Hunter's Hill is a Horde tauren village located on the High Road in Southern Barrens. The orcs use this village as their base to continue their sneak attacks on Honor's Stand. Years ago the Grimtotem tribe raided this village, killing many tauren. The Alliance lays siege to Hunter's Hill to attempt to capture it and control passage between the Barrens and Stonetalon Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Huntress Davinia is a high elf huntress located in Stonetalon Mountains. She owns the Alliance attack plans that Horde adventurers have to take over.

__NOTOC__ Huntress Illiona is a night elf quest giver located at the Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Illiona is the squad leader of the huntresses send to obtain information about the Horde operations in Stonetalon. She was captured alongside her sisters by the Horde.
__NOTOC__ Huolon is a cloud serpent flying above the Firewalkers' Path on the Timeless Isle.
Hungry Virmen are virmen found in the Brewmoon Festival scenario.
Hunter's Call is sold to hunters by the following for : * at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin * at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain
The Hungry Wolf is found within Akazamzarak's Hat. It has been eating The Great Akazamzarak's Magical Rabbits.
__NOTOC__ Huntress Kasparian is a night elf ghost located at the Font of Elune in the Terrace of the Moon of the Tomb of Sargeras.
Hungry Eyes are beholder eyes that briefly spawn as a part of the Durumu the Forgotten encounter in the Throne of Thunder.

Hunter McAlister is a human located in Redridge Pass in Redridge Mountains. He was approached by Marion Sutton and Sophia who asked about an orc passing through here. His dogs started growling at Marion, and McAlister realized that they were Horde in disguise. Using his flare, he exposed them as Dark Ranger Lyana and a Horde adventurer, but they killed him.
Hungry Rest is a cave located in the Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island. It is home to a Scrapbone Colossus.

The Hungry Nether Ray is a nether ray located in Terokkar Forest, Skettis. It is summoned with the Nether Ray Cage. The Hungry Nether Ray seems to be a tamed netherwing ray which is a loyal mount which only feeds on freshly-killed Blackwind Warp Chasers and flies better when fed. Despite following the player it doesn't actually fly and stays on the ground.
__NOTOC__ Huntress Arnithal is a night elf located in Shepherd's Bluff in Stormsong Valley. She is accompanied by Moonclaw.

Huntsman Altimor is a boss in Castle Nathria. Altimor is a hunter who fights the raid with a trio of gargon, each with a different set of abilities, but all sharing the same health pool with Altimor. Margore will leap at enemies, Bargast creates ghostly shades of itself, and Hecutis uses overwhelming stone might to crush the raid. Huntsman Altimor is typically fought as the second boss, after Shriekwing, as is seen as one of the easier bosses in the instance.

__NOTOC__ Hungry Bloodtalons are hawks flying around Slicky Stream, Dookin' Grounds, and near Scenic Overlook in the Jade Forest. They can be seen swooping down on critters and devouring dead Grookin Whomper.
Huraq is a centaur flight master located in Ohn'iri Springs in the Ohn'ahran Plains and the Nokhud Offensive.
Hungry Overseers are two orcs who approach Chef Audrey in the Undercity after completing Roach Coach.

The Hydraxian Waterlords (or the Warlords) are water elementals that made their home on the islands east of Azshara. They are sworn enemies of the armies of Ragnaros. Acting on rumors planted by Moira Thaurissan, they worked to banish Ragnaros back into the Elemental Plane, offering aid and rewards to anyone who would challenge the Firelord.
The Hyper-Radiant Flame Reflector can be used to reflect fire-based magic back at the caster. Even when the trinket isn't activated, it still provides the fire resistance.

"I Am Murloc" is the second song by Level 80 Elite Tauren Chieftain, which made its live debut on July 16, 2007 at the year's annual BlizzCon. The song "appears" on the band's fictional 2007 album, Udder Chaos. "I Am Murloc" was written about the glorification of the titular Murloc race, of the Warcraft universe. On June 29, 2008 at the Worldwide Invitational in Paris, France, the band performed a slightly modified version including a chorus in French, ending with "Je suis Murloc" (literally "I am Murloc").

in the TCG.]] , a powerful hydromancer troll.]] The name hydromancer (aka aquamancer, aquamage, and squallshaper) is generally accepted to refer to spellcasters who specialize in water-based spells or hydromancy.

Hyperspeed Accelerators is an Engineer-only permanent "enchant" to gloves. This item may be used alongside a normal enchant on the same pair of gloves. Because it does not trigger the global cooldown, it can be macroed into damage abilities to provide a passive damage boost.
I Could Say That This Cache Was Rare (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned defeating Hodir before he shatters his rare cache on 10-player mode.

Hutihu is an owl found in Silverwing Grove of Ashenvale. Su'ura Swiftarrow is the pet owner. During the Ashenvale war, Hutihu accompanied its master to Silverwing Outpost. The owl alerted Su'ura of the approaching Illiyana Moonblaze who announced the Horde presence. When the Horde invaded, Su'ura sent Hutihu to the trees.
Hyeyoung Parka is a taunka flight master located at Camp Tunka'lo in the The Storm Peaks.
I Can't Hear You Over The Sound of How Awesome I Am is a Feat of Strength for a flawless victory over Sinestra.

I Am Forsaken is a machinima entry for Blizzcon 2010. It Placed Second in the Machinima Contest.The story of a Gilnean apothecary who loses everything he had. Moving to Lordaeron for a fresh start, Luscieus Grayson finds himself within the walls of the famed Capital City during its final moments. Family, love, and life; all cherished possessions he once held close to his heart, cherished possessions that are nothing more than a mere memory. *Machinima by Gary Lobine *Music Composer Walid Feghali *Writer and Director Jesse O Connor 9FOpI0EsQ8A

__NOTOC__ Hypnocroak is found in the Vile Cavern halfway up a cliff on the west side of the Nightmarsh, and requires a platforming exercise to get up to the mouth of the cave (or jumping down from Moonwillow Peak. Its corpse contains the Hypnosis Goggles and 10-20x Garrison Resources.
Hyjal Screechers are owls found flying around the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
Huts are neutral buildings primarily used for map decoration, although in single player missions some can reveal items when destroyed.
Hutou Featherwind is the flight master located at Axefall in Spires of Arak.
Hymdall is a powerful valarjar iron vrykul and guardian of the Halls of Valor.
I Ain't Even Cold is an achievement earned by defeating Ash'Golm in Vault of the Wardens on Mythic difficulty while all members of the party are inflicted by the Fired Up ability.

Hydrannon is a water elemental located at the Straits of Hydrannon in Stormheim. Shaman players can interact with it to begin a one-time mini-game, where you need to collect 10 bubbles and return them to Hydrannon — while avoiding the sharks. Successfully completing the mini-game will award you 50 Artifact Power, which does not scale with Artifact Knowledge.

I Attack the Darkness is an achievement earned by killing a Creature in the Dark during every phase of the Xavius encounter in the Emerald Nightmare instance and then defeating the boss, on Normal difficulty or higher. Xavius has three separate phases at 100%, 65%, and 30% health. The Creature in the Dark can be found in the darkness which surrounds the room where the encounter takes place. The add cannot be seen, and requires certain abilities such as a demon hunter's Spectral Sight to be able to target it. Once located, the Creature in the Dark should be pulled into the main area of the room, where it can be killed normally. Do this during each of the fight's three phases, then kill Xavius

Hyperbolic Circuit could be used to repair a Smashed Transport Relay with a Transference Disc, and an Energy Cell, resulting in a Nullifier Transport Relay. The repaired item would then be used to summon the Mechagonian Nullifier at Junkwatt Depot on Mechagon Island.

"Icecrown and the Frozen Throne" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter IV. It is set shortly after Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal. Found at: * Reliquary of Scholomance in the Western Plaguelands * Lion's Pride Inn of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest * Athenaeum of the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades * The Apothecarium of Undercity - near Herbalism trainers * The Scarlet Bastion (live side) of Stratholme Timeline: * ← Previous book: The Birth of the Lich King * → Next book: The Battle of Grim Batol

Ice Trap is a Hunter ability learned at level 46. It provides an area that slows movement speed of enemies in the affected area by 50%. It can be used to slow enemies multiple times since you can always lead the mob over the ice slick to easily reapply the snare. This makes kiting mobs, especially multiple mobs, in circles much easier.

Icemist Village is located on the edge of Lake Wintergrasp within the Dragonblight. The ravaged settlement was destroyed by undead nerubians and is currently controlled by the Scourge forces out of Azjol Nerub. The Scourge forces here were once led by Under-King Anub'et'kan, who captured the taunka chieftain Roanauk Icemist during the attack. Adventurers of the Horde were later sent to save Roanauk and kill Anub'et'kan.
Icebane Bracers are Blacksmithing-made plate bracers that give a bonus to stamina, strength, frost resistance and an increase of defense.
Icebane Gauntlets are Blacksmithing-made plate gloves that give a bonus to stamina, strength, dodge and frost resistance.
Icebane Breastplate is a Blacksmithing-made plate chest piece that gives a bonus to stamina, strength, defense and frost resistance.
__NOTOC__ Icebane Pauldrons are drop plate shoulders that give a bonus to strength, stamina, frost resistance and an increase defense.
__NOTOC__ Icebane Helmet is a drop plate head that give a bonus to strength, stamina, frost resistance and an increase defense.

I win button refers to any skill that other players feel is overpowered in PvP combat. The suggestion is made that players need only one button on their UI, and can simply mash it to achieve victory. Blizzard lampooned this attitude with the Broken I.W.I.N. Button, which sometimes drops from player corpses in Alterac Valley.

Iceblood Tower is located just south / behind Iceblood Garrison and it the northen most horde tower in Alterac Valley. It is one of the first two / three horde targets for the alliance when the battle starts – especially if the alliance lack the strength to take down Galvangar in Iceblood Garrison. Like Tower Point, it is protected by 4 Frostwolf Bowmen. There are no archers on the middle platform of the tower – all the archers are on the top of the tower. If killed, they will respawn after a length of time (if tower is still under horde control). It is possible for an alliance player to bypass and not kill any of Frostwolf Bowmen and capture the flag due to the design of the 'flag room'. Th
The ice giants are a classification of mountain giants found in cold and snowy regions.

Ian Drake is a human who can be found in the Trade District of Stormwind City. He offers players who attended the 2008 Worldwide Invitational the opportunity to redeem their code for Tyrael's Hilt. He can be found near the central square of the district, across from Weller's Arsenal.
Icebound Fortitude is a death knight ability that allows the death knight to become immune to stun effects and take less damage.
Ice Turrets are aggressive mechanical fixtures dropped by Clockwork Sappers in the Corridors of Ingenuity in Ulduar raid instance. Clockwork Sappers are the pilots of Arachnopod Destroyers.
The Iceblood Warmaster guards Drek'Thar in Frostwolf Keep in Alterac Valley until Iceblood Tower is destroyed.
The Iceblood Marshal guarded Vanndar Stormpike in the fortress of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley after the Iceblood Tower was destroyed.
Ice Tomb is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
I Thought He Was Supposed to Be Hard? is a feat of strength for a flawless victory over Ra-den.
Ice Spike is an ability used by Boneshard, Snobold Runt, and Winter Rageling during a Pet Battle.
Ice in Your Veins is a Frost death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Chill of the Grave (death knight artifact trait), Over-Powered, and Cold as Ice traits.
Iceheart is an unbound water elemental located in Island Expeditions.
Icecrag Mountainbreakers are gronn located in Frostfire Ridge.

The Icon of Shadows is the racial icon of the Darkspear trolls, and symbolizes their worship of dark loa and use of shadowy voodoo magics. The crest features a tusked tiki mask resting atop a trio of spears, representing the Darkspear tribe. Dark leather straps criss-cross the shafts of the spears and additional wooden staves, forming a web from which hang a variety of fetishes, alchemical concoctions and a voodoo doll.

.]] The Icon of Courage is the racial icon of the humans, and symbolizes the courage and tenacity of humanity. The crest features a shield emblazoned with the symbol of the fallen Kingdom of Lordaeron over a pair of crossed swords and a warhammer accented with a golden lion's head, representing courage and the Kingdom of Stormwind.

__NOTOC__ Ilkrud Magthrull was an orc warlock who made his residence at the Fire Scar Shrine, a place of great evil in southwestern Ashenvale. He is one of the most loyal servants of Athrikus Narassin and member of the Cult of the Dark Strand. Delgren the Purifier wanted Magthrull's magical tome.

__NOTOC__ Ichor of Undeath drops from undead mobs in Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. Powerful undead are sometimes so infused with evil that it coalesces into a sickly greenish goo. This substance is known to the living as the ichor of undeath and is a highly potent poison.

The Icon of Blood is the racial crest of the blood elves. It symbolizes their fall and subsequent rise during the Third War. The drop of blood represents their brethren who fell to the Scourge, while the phoenix on the shield is a Resurgam representing their own survival and return to power in Quel'Thalas. The golden leaves likely represent the forests of Eversong Woods.

The Icon of Torment is the racial icon of the Undead Forsaken, and symbolizes the torment they suffered as a result of the Plague of Undeath. The crest features a shattered porcelain mask shedding purple tears, likely representing Sylvanas Windrunner. This rests atop a trio of arrows, one of which is broken and possibly representing the Windrunner sisters, which in turn rest atop a shield in the shape of a raven, a symbol of death.

Icy Scale Gauntlets are Leatherworking-made mail gloves that give a bonus to stamina, attack power and frost resistance. The recipe to make this can no longer be learned. The Frozen Rune material component is also no longer available.

Icy Scale Breastplate is a Leatherworking-made mail chest piece that gives a bonus to stamina, attack power and frost resistance. The recipe to make this can no longer be learned. The Frozen Rune material component is also no longer available.

The Idol of Remulos was given to Broll Bearmantle by Remulos, to help Broll channel his druidic powers. The Idol is shaped like and connected to a green dragon, and connects Broll with the Emerald Dream. During the Battle for Mount Hyjal, the pitlord Azgalor attacked Broll with fel energy. When Broll fell he dropped the idol, and it is said that Azgalor struck the idol with his sword, Spite, and infused it with fel energy. Broll's daughter, Anessa, tried to save Broll from the corrupting energies of the idol, but she was too late, the idol exploded and killed her instantly. She had a husband and children, and was friends with a couple or family named the Whisperveils; all of them were killed by Kreug Oathbreaker, and later Illusia posted a wanted poster to have him killed.
The Image of Archmage Modera is a human quest giver at Stars' Rest in the Dragonblight. Another image appeared in the Hall of the Guardian.

Illidan's Servitors are a group of satyr within Illidan's forces and followers of Illidan Stormrage. A group of from Illidan's Servitors were allied with Illidan's Naga. Improved Sinister Strike is a Rogue talent located in the 1st tier of the Combat Tree that increases damage dealt by and reduces the energy cost of the Sinister Strike ability and increases its damage.

Improved Counterspell is a passive ability for mages, available at level 70. It gives the Counterspell a silence effect in addition to the spell interrupt. Counterspell normally only locks a single school, and must be timed to interrupt a spell being cast. Improved Counterspell can be used at any time as a silence, stopping all casting for 4 seconds, including instant spells, without having to time it to interrupt a cast. Counterspell still retains its normal function; the silence is simply an added benefit.
Improved Heroic Strike reduces the rage cost of the Heroic Strike ability.

Improved Enslave Demon was a warlock talent in the Demonology tree, you needed to spend 27 points in Demonology to max it. This was a potentially-powerful talent to have, depending on style of play. If you enslave demons, such as the summonable Infernal and Doomguard, often, or appreciated the added utility option, then this was well worth taking. If not, then this talent was not a good option.
